# AutoStatus

<img src="info/icon.png" alt="AutoStatus" width="64" height="64" />

**Keeps completion status honest—stale "Playing" games go On Hold, and starting a game sets it back to Playing.**

**[Download AutoStatus 1.0.0](https://github.com/danitesler/playnite-extensions/releases/tag/autostatus-v1.0.0)**

## About

Your "Playing" list fills up with games you dropped months ago, and games marked On Hold or Plan to Play stay that way after you pick them back up.

AutoStatus fixes both with two rules:
- Games still marked Playing that you have not played for a set number of days (30 by default) move to On Hold.
- Starting a game that is On Hold, Abandoned, or Plan to Play sets it back to Playing.

Both rules use your own completion statuses, so you can pick any source and target. Games you have never played in Playnite are left alone, and a game you just marked Playing again is not moved back until the window passes. Rules run at startup, every 6 hours, after saving settings, and from the Extensions menu.

## Install

1. **Inside Playnite:** open **Add-ons** from the main menu, browse or search for **AutoStatus**, and install it from there.
2. **Or from GitHub:** download the `.pext` file from the release page (see Download above) and open it in **Windows** (double-click it or drag it onto Playnite).
3. Click **Install** when Playnite prompts you, then restart Playnite.
